relations.subject: Geiger
relations.evidence: Geiger, who was born in Nuremberg in 1856, studied Oriental languages under Friedrich von Spiegel at the University of Erlangen.

relations.subject: Geiger
relations.evidence: Geiger took the degree of Dr. phil. with a thesis on an Avestan text ("Die Pehleviversion des Ersten Capitels des Vendīdād") in 1877.

relations.subject: Geiger
relations.evidence: became lecturer (Privatdozent) in Erlangen after he had presented his edition of the Aogemadaēcā (1878) as his "Habilitationsschrift".

relations.subject: Geiger
relations.object: Gymnasium at Neustadt an der Haardt
relations.evidence: Geiger was forced to earn a livelihood as a teacher of Latin and Greek at the Gymnasium at Neustadt an der Haardt from 1880 to 1884

relations.subject: Geiger
relations.evidence: In 1884, Geiger was appointed teacher at the Maximilians-Gymnasium in Munich

relations.subject: Geiger
relations.evidence: besides which he was also a lecturer at the University of Munich from 1886.

relations.subject: Geiger
relations.evidence: During this time he won the intimate friendship of Ernst Kuhn and of Mark Aurel Stein
